chunks: It was narrated to me by Ali ibn Ahmad ibn Abdillah from his father from his grandfather Ahmad ibn Abi Abdillah from his father from Uthman ibn Isa from Ali ibn Salim from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
The severest punishment of the people on the Day of Resurrection is a man who released his semen in a womb that was prohibited for him.

key_terms.أَشَدَّ النَّاسِ عَذَاباً: the severest punishment of the people

ai.seo_question: What is the punishment for a man who releases semen into a prohibited womb?
ai.summary: Shaykh al-Saduq highlights the severe eschatological penalty for a man who ejaculates into the womb of a woman with whom he has a specific prohibited sexual connection, such as a temporary wife (Mut'ah) or a free woman in a context where full penetration is restricted. This narration underscores the gravity of violating the precise boundaries of lawful intimacy, distinguishing it from general adultery by focusing on the specific legal status of the woman involved.

en.sayed-athar-husain-rizvi-&-sayed-maqs: 7. It was narrated to me by Ali b. Ahmad b. Abdillah from his father from his grandfather Ahmad b. Abi Abdillah from his father from Uthman b. Isa from Ali b. Salim from Abi Abdillah (a.s.) who said: “
The punishment of that person will be the severest who released his semen in a womb, which was prohibited for him.”
